title: Balanced Nutrition and Refusal of Food
summary: Picky eating is common at this age and is often temporary. Do not force your child, nor turn the meal into a battle. Offer a variety of healthy options and let them choose the quantity, and be a role model in eating. Reduce sugars between meals. Consult a doctor if they lose weight or consistently refuse entire food groups.
try_this: This week: Present a plate with one new item alongside foods they like, without pressure or forcing them to eat.
reflection_prompts: What does your child refuse the most?
Have meals turned into a struggle?
